basis.governing_question: How does Banco Atlântico roll out its new branch operating model across 120 branches, with all running it by week 24?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the new branch operating model to all 120 branches, with staff trained and results tracked, by week 24.

gate.label: Rollout close-out
gate.decision: Do all 120 branches run the new model so the rollout can close?

workstreams.name: Branch rollout
workstreams.answers: How do the 120 branches move onto the new operating model, wave by wave, by week 24?
activities: Sequence the 120 branches into rollout waves
Launch the new model in waves after the readiness review
Resolve issues raised by branches during go-live

workstreams.name: Staff training
workstreams.answers: How are branch staff prepared to run the new model before their branch goes live?
activities: Design role-based training for the new branch model
Train branch staff ahead of each rollout wave

workstreams.name: Performance tracking
workstreams.answers: How do we show whether each branch is running the new model and meeting its KPIs?
activities: Set the baseline from branch operational data
Agree KPIs with the COO and the Head of Branch Network
Track branch results by wave against the KPIs

deliverables.name: Rollout plan with branch waves and readiness criteria
Rollout completion report for all 120 branches
Training curriculum and materials for branch staff
Agreed KPI set and baseline for the 120 branches

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, roles and the plan
events.decision: Is the scope of the 120-branch rollout confirmed for the 24 weeks?
agenda: Present the rollout scope, the three workstreams and the 24-week plan
Align on roles, steering meetings and the week 24 target
Confirm access to branch data for the baseline

events.label: Workshop 1: readiness
events.purpose: Review readiness before the first go-live
events.decision: Do the plan, training and KPIs clear the first wave to go live?
agenda: Review the rollout plan, waves and readiness criteria
Review the training materials and the agreed KPI baseline
Decide whether the first wave may go live

events.label: Mid-phase check-in
events.decision: Do the first-wave results call for changes before the next waves?
agenda: Review first-wave results in the performance tracker
Discuss changes needed before the next waves

events.label: Workshop 2: rollout results
events.purpose: Review results and the last waves
events.decision: Are the remaining branches on track to run the new model by week 24?
agenda: Review results by wave in the performance tracker
Review training coverage across all 120 branches
Confirm the schedule for the last waves

events.label: Rollout close-out
events.purpose: Confirm the result against the target
events.decision: Do all 120 branches run the new model so the rollout can close?
agenda: Present the completion report on all 120 branches
Review final results against the KPIs and the week 24 target
Decide whether the rollout can close

architect_notes: Closest archetype is performance improvement, with its Diagnostic phase dropped because the model is already designed; confirm no branch readiness assessment is needed.
Tracking after week 24 and transfer of the tracker to the client's team are not in this phase; confirm whether either is in scope.
